content: Mɔwisi Gusunɔn sɔm kowo u kɑnɑru kuɑ u nɛɛ,

content.text: Yinni, sɑɑ yellun di, wunɑ ɑ sɑ̃ɑ bɛsɛn kuku yeru.
A sɑ̃ɑwɑ Gusunɔ ɑ sere ɡuunu kɑ hɑnduniɑ tɑkɑ kuɑ.
Mɛyɑ kɑɑ n mɑɑ sɑ̃ɑ sere kɑ bɑɑdommɑɔ.
A rɑ de tɔnu u ɡɔsirɑ tuɑ.
A rɑ nùn sɔ̃ ɑ nɛɛ, u ɡɔsiro min di, u we.
Wunɛn mi, wɔ̃ɔ nɔrɔbu (1.000) rɑ n sɑ̃ɑwɑ nɡe ɡĩɑn tɔ̃ru te tɑ doonɑ kɔ,
ǹ kun mɛ nɡe wɔ̃kurun sɑ̃kiru.
A rɑ tɔnun wɑ̃ɑru nɔru koosiewɑ nɡe mɛ dosu ɡɑ rɑ doonɛ bururu.
Gɑ ku rɑ tɛ nɡe yɑkɑsu
sìn wɛ̃su rɑ n bɑɑre bururu,
ǹ n kuɑ yokɑ bu su burɑ kpɑ su ɡberɑ.
Wunɛn mɔru yɑ derɑ sɑ ɡɔɔ dɔɔ.
Mɑ sɑ nɑndɑ yen sɑɑbu.
A rɑ bɛsɛn torɑnu terɑsiewɑ wunɛn wuswɑɑɔ,
kpɑ wunɛn yɑm bururɑm mu bɛsɛn ɑsiri kpuro sɔ̃ɔsi.
Bɛsɛn wɑ̃ɑru tɑ rɑ doonɛwɑ wunɛn mɔrun sɔ̃.
Tɑ rɑ doonɛwɑ nɡe wɛ̃siɑ teeru.
Tɔnun wɑ̃ɑru tɑ rɑ turi sere wɔ̃ɔ wɑtɑ kɑ wɔkuru,
wi u mɑɑ dɑm mɔ, wɔ̃ɔ wɛnɛ,
ɑdɑmɑ kɑ mɛ, tɔnun wɑ̃ɑrɑ ku rɑ n ɑrufɑɑni ɡɑɑ mɔ
sere wɑhɑlɑ kɑ nɔni swɑ̃ɑru.
Domi tɑ rɑ doonɛwɑ fuuku ɡɔri ɡiɑ.
Wɑrɑ u wunɛn mɔrun dɑm yɛ̃.
Wɑrɑ u nun nɑsie yen sɔ̃.
A de sɑ n yɛ̃ mɑ bɛsɛn wɑ̃ɑrun tɔ̃rɑ kun dɛ̃u,
kpɑ su ko bwisiɡibu.
Yinni Gusunɔ, sere dommɑ kɑɑ ɡɔ̃ru ɡɔsiɑ ɑ wunɛn mɔru deri.
A bɛsɛ wunɛn sɔm kowobun wɔnwɔndu wɑɑwo.
A sun wunɛn durom bɑkɑm sɔ̃ɔsio bururu bɑɑtere.
Kpɑ sɑ n nuku dobu mɔ sɑ n womusu mɔ̀ bɛsɛn wɑ̃ɑrun tɔ̃ru kpuro sɔɔ.
A sun nuku dobu wɛ̃ɛyɔ nɡe mɛ̀n nɔɔ ɑ sun sɛɛyɑsiɑ.
Kpɑ ɑ bɛsɛn nuku sɑnkirɑ ten wɔ̃su ɡɔsiɑ nuku dobun wɔ̃su.
A de su wunɛn sɔmɑ wɑ bɛsɛ wunɛn sɔm kowobu,
kpɑ ɑ bɛsɛn bibun bweseru wunɛn yiiko sɔ̃ɔsi.
Gusunɔ bɛsɛn Yinni, ɑ sun durom kuo,
kpɑ ɑ de bɛsɛn sɔmɑ kpuro yu ɑrufɑɑni ko.
